description: Work out UK employee Class 1 National Insurance for the 2026/27 tax year from an annual gross salary. Uses the primary threshold of £12,570, upper earnings limit of £50,270, 8% between them and 2% above. Returns NI due per year, month and week plus the effective rate. Amounts in GBP.
